explanation: On the paraboloid, the outward vector area element is ⟨2x,2y,1⟩ dA, giving F·dS=[-2x(5-x²-y²)+x] dA. The bottom disk has outward normal ⟨0,0,-1⟩ and contributes -x dA. Adding gives 2x³+2xy²-10x, option b. All displayed expressions integrate to zero by symmetry, but b directly represents the combined surface contributions.
